plugins.name: sci-paper
plugins.description: Scientific paper writing + review + ideation pipeline for top-tier journals (ApJ/MNRAS/PRD/JCAP-class). Ships 8 skills (paper, paper-review, figure-review, paper-style, brainstorm, mainline, paper-attack-tree, final-review) and 7 corpus-driven style tools. See CHANGELOG.md for per-version history.
